info.title: Moorcheh Universal API
info.description: Moorcheh provides REST APIs for namespaces, semantic search, text/vector data ingestion, document retrieval, file upload URLs, deletion, and AI answer generation.

post.description: Creates a new namespace in Moorcheh.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

namespace_name.description: Unique namespace name using only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

type.description: Namespace type: text for documents or vector for pre-computed embeddings.

vector_dimension.description: Required for vector namespaces. Dimension of vectors to be stored, such as 1536.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Name of the text namespace to fetch text chunks from.

schema.description: Name of the text namespace to fetch text chunks from.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

is_summary.description: Whether this item is a summary chunk.

post.description: Generates an AI answer in Moorcheh from your data.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

namespace.description: Namespace for search mode, or an empty string for direct AI mode.

top_k.description: Number of relevant chunks to use in search mode. Defaults to 10 in Moorcheh.

threshold.description: Minimum relevance score from 0 to 1. Required when kiosk mode is enabled.

temperature.description: AI creativity level from 0.0 to 2.0. Moorcheh defaults to 0.7.

ai_model.description: Optional Moorcheh AI model ID such as deepseek.r1-v1:0.

kiosk_mode.description: Enable threshold-based filtering for namespace-backed answers.

header_prompt.description: Optional instruction prepended to the model prompt.

footer_prompt.description: Optional instruction appended to the prompt. Moorcheh defaults to a concise-answer instruction.

get.description: Finds relevant results in Moorcheh across selected namespaces.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query text. Metadata and keyword filters can be placed at the end of the query using Moorcheh syntax.

schema.description: Search query text. Metadata and keyword filters can be placed at the end of the query using Moorcheh syntax.

parameters.name: namespaces[]
parameters.description: Array of namespace names to search. All namespaces must be of the same type.

schema.description: Array of namespace names to search. All namespaces must be of the same type.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top relevant chunks to return. Defaults to 10 in Moorcheh.

schema.description: Number of top relevant chunks to return. Defaults to 10 in Moorcheh.

parameters.name: kiosk_mode
parameters.description: When enabled, Moorcheh filters chunks below the threshold.

schema.description: When enabled, Moorcheh filters chunks below the threshold.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Minimum relevance score from 0 to 1. Required by Moorcheh when kiosk mode is enabled.

schema.description: Minimum relevance score from 0 to 1. Required by Moorcheh when kiosk mode is enabled.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the result.
